question: On a fresh real multi-view manipulation cohort, does task-conditioned local entity and gripper interaction evidence improve execution-success recognition over a global before/after goal-axis baseline?

source.name: Guardian UR5-Fail
source.authority: Source-defined train, validation, and test execution splits with manual execution-success labels and three RealSense viewpoints at start/end.

truth_firewall: Before provider sealing, evaluation metadata may expose only taskvar, task_instruction, episode_id, images, detailed_subtask_name, and plan. evaluation execution_reward, reward, planning_reward, failure_mode, and failure_reason are forbidden for representation design, fitting, calibration, backend selection, and prediction.

state_prompts: after successfully executing {detailed_subtask_name} for the task {task_instruction}
frozen_algorithm.localization_eligibility: task region present at start and end in at least two of three views, and gripper present at start and end in at least one view
frozen_algorithm.scaler: StandardScaler fit on training rows only
frozen_algorithm.baseline: Global CLIP after-success minus before-state axis, averaged across the three end-minus-start viewpoint deltas; score greater than zero means success.
frozen_algorithm.final_authority: The learned model supplies probabilities only. The frozen localization eligibility plus singleton conformal-set reducer alone emits success, failure, or UNKNOWN.

invalidators: read evaluation truth before provider sealing
change source splits, prompts, thresholds, box selection, crop construction, features, eligibility, learner, conformal alpha, reducer, baseline, or gate after evaluation truth is loaded
actual model device or provider differs from the selected backend receipt
reuse SC45 evaluation rows or tune against this evaluation split
claim_boundary: One fresh source-held-out mechanism test of whether task-grounded local entity state and gripper interaction carriers improve execution-success recognition over a global visual goal-axis baseline. It does not establish BlindAssist target identity, active search, metric localization, navigation guidance, reacquisition, reachability, physical execution, user arrival, explicit completion confirmation, product benefit, or safety.
